items.title: 22.2 Alcohols aur phenols ki tezaabiyat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the acidity of alcohols and phenols (PDF 90-91).

blocks.text: Alcohols paani mein bohat kam toot'te hain: equilibrium ROH(aq) <=> RO-(aq) + H+(aq) bohat baen taraf hai, is liye ions ke muqable mein alcohol molecules kaheen zyada hain. Paani bhi bohat kam toot'ta hai, H2O(l) <=> OH-(aq) + H+(aq), lekin alcohol se zyada H+ ions deta hai. Is liye alcohols, kam [H+] ke saath, paani se kamzor tezaab hain.

Alcohols apne alkyl groups ki wajah se paani se kam tezaabi hain. Alkyl groups electron dene wale hain: yeh electrons ko oxygen ki taraf dhakelte hain (musbat inductive effect). Is se alkoxide ion, jo alcohol ke H+ khone par bachta hai, na-mustahkam hota hai, kyunke manfi oxygen par electron density mazeed barh jati hai. Is liye alkoxide ion H+ wapas le kar alcohol dobara banane par zyada maail hota hai.

blocks.alt: Khuli banawat wala ethanol (aq) ethoxide ion (aq) + H+ (aq) ke saath equilibrium mein. Ethoxide ion mein C-C aur C-O- bonds par teer ke nishan O- ki taraf. Do peele dabbe: 'position of the equilibrium lies to left' (equilibrium teeron ki taraf ishara) aur 'alkyl group donates electron density towards O- which is more likely to accept H+ again to form CH3CH2OH' (H+ ki taraf ishara). Labels: ethanol, ethoxide ion, hydrogen ion.
blocks.caption: Ethanol ka toot'na (dissociation): ethanol, ethoxide ion aur hydrogen ion (kitab ke PDF safha 90 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Ethoxide ion mein bonds par bane teer ke nishan (>) batate hain ke alkyl group electrons O- ki taraf dhakelta hai (+I effect). Is se O- par manfi charge aur ziada ho jata hai, woh H+ ko wapas kheench kar ethanol bana leta hai, is liye equilibrium baen taraf rehta hai. Kitab ke peele dabbe mein 'to from' chhapa hai; sahi 'to form' hai.

Phenol ka -OH group hone ke bawajood yeh kamzor tezaab hai, paani se zyada tezaabi. Oxygen ka aik lone pair ring ke delocalised pi nizam se milta hai, is liye phenoxide ion, C6H5O-, mein manfi charge oxygen par rehne ki bajaye ring par phail jata hai. Is se phenoxide ion mustahkam hota hai: oxygen par charge density kam hone se H+ ions zor se wapas nahi khinchte, is liye phenol proton khone (tezaab banne) par proton lene se zyada maail hai.

blocks.alt: Phenol (aq) phenoxide ion (aq), yani O- wala benzene ring, + H+ (aq) ke saath equilibrium mein. Labels: phenol, phenoxide ion.
blocks.caption: Phenol ka toot'na: phenol aur phenoxide ion (kitab ke PDF safha 91 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Phenoxide ion: chhe surmayi carbon atoms ka ring, paanch chhote H atoms aur aik laal O atom. Carbon ring ke oopar aur neeche do neele chhalle phaila hua pi nizam (extended pi system) hain jo O tak pohanchte hain; O ke paas manfi charge ka nishan. O par do neele lobes '2 x sp2 - orbitals' hain.
blocks.caption: Oxygen ka manfi charge aromatic ring par phail (delocalise ho) jata hai, is liye ion mustahkam hai (kitab ke PDF safha 91 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Phenoxide ion mein O ka aik lone pair p orbital mein hai jo ring ke pi nizam se mil jata hai; neele chhalle dikhate hain ke pi nizam ring se O tak phaila hua hai. Is tarah manfi charge sirf O par nahi rehta, poore ring par phail jata hai aur ion mustahkam hota hai. O ke baqi do lone pairs do sp2 orbitals (neele lobes) mein hain jo ring ki satah mein hain.

blocks.prompt: Methanol aur ethanol ki tezaabi taqat ka muqabla karein.
blocks.explanation: Methanol thora zyada tezaabi hai: ethanol ka ethyl group methyl group se zyada electron density oxygen par dhakelta hai, is liye ethoxide methoxide se kam mustahkam hai.

blocks.prompt: Electron delocalisation se samjhayein ke phenoxide ion (C6H5O-) ethoxide ion (C2H5O-) se zyada mustahkam kyun hai.
blocks.explanation: Phenoxide mein manfi oxygen ka lone pair ring ke pi nizam se milta hai, is liye charge oxygen aur ring par phail jata hai. Ethoxide mein charge oxygen par hi rehta aur ethyl group us par mazeed electron density dhakelta hai.

blocks.prompt: Do beakers mein sodium dala jata hai, aik mein ethanol aur aik mein phenol. (a) Kis mein hydrogen jaldi aur tezi se nikalti hai? (b) Agar sodium dalne se pehle phenolphthalein maujood ho to kaun pehle gulabi hota hai?
blocks.explanation: (a) Phenol, zyada taqatwar tezaab, tezi se react karta hai. (b) Ethanol: banne wala sodium ethoxide taqatwar base hai aur phenolphthalein ko gulabi karta, jab ke sodium phenoxide sirf kamzor base hai aur bacha hua phenol mehlool ko halka tezaabi rakhta hai.

items: Alcohols paani se kamzor tezaab: alkyl groups alkoxide ion ko na-mustahkam karte.
Phenol kamzor tezaab: phenoxide ring mein delocalisation se mustahkam.
